comparison.heading: Why Plantipedia Outperforms Static Plant Blogs
comparison.lead: Filter our core architectural capabilities below to see how an indexed, bilingual botanical data lake replaces fragmented gardening articles.

rows.traditional: English-only keyword match; misses Bengali common names, regional dialects, and Latin binomials.
rows.plantipedia: Sub-50ms client-side search across English, বাংলা script (e.g., আম, শাপলা), Latin binomials, and plant families.

rows.traditional: No structured attribution or exportable bibliographic metadata for student papers.
rows.plantipedia: One-click institutional citations in APA 7th, MLA 9th, and BibTeX formats with canonical specimen URLs.

rows.traditional: Requires opening multiple browser tabs and manually scanning prose paragraphs.
rows.plantipedia: Synchronized dual-pane workspace comparing taxonomy, morphology, ecology, and cultivation side by side.

rows.traditional: Generic temperate four-season advice unsuited for Bengal's monsoon-alluvial climate.
rows.plantipedia: Tracks active flowering, fruiting, and flushing across all six Shororitu (গ্রীষ্ম through বসন্ত).

rows.traditional: Vague phrases like 'prefers normal soil' without quantifiable pH bands or drainage metrics.

rows.traditional: Forces account creation, email walls, or cookie-heavy tracking before saving plants.
rows.plantipedia: Instant browser-local Herbarium drawer persists saved specimens privately with zero sign-up friction.

rows.traditional: Dense terminology left unexplained or requires leaving the article to search external dictionaries.
rows.plantipedia: Auto-detected scientific terms reveal instant English & বাংলা definitions on hover, focus, or tap.

globalArchitecture.heading: Zero-Key Worldwide Flora Uplink & Botanical Validation
globalArchitecture.lead: Beyond the 50 curated monographs, Plantipedia's Zero-Key Global Server Engine resolves 390,000+ worldwide vascular species on demand with automated taxonomic verification.

pillars.title: Real-Time Taxonomic Resolution
pillars.description: Resolves common English names, Linnaean binomials, and regional vernacular titles directly against the Worldwide Flora Registry—extracting kingdom, family, genus, and morphological summaries without API keys or rate paywalls.

pillars.title: Bilingual EN / বাংলা Cross-Referencing
pillars.description: Pairs English scientific records with Bengali vernacular nomenclature and delta ecology cues whenever available, letting students and regional growers bridge academic Latin and local flora terminology seamlessly.

pillars.title: Fault-Tolerant 5-Second Retry & Botanical Verification Pipeline
pillars.description: Applies strict kingdom Plantae classification filters to reject non-botanical queries, executes automatic 5-second timeout and retry telemetry, and routes invalid lookups to Smart 404 recovery with zero broken views.

pipeline.heading: How Live Queries Become Structured 8-Chapter Monographs
pipeline.lead: Select any stage in the pipeline diagram below to inspect its telemetry targets, schema mapping rules, and fallback safeguards.

steps.title: Query Dispatch
steps.description: Normalizes user queries across English, Latin binomials, and Unicode বাংলা script, strips redundant punctuation, and checks session-scoped monograph caches before dispatching a cancellable AbortController request to the Global Botanical Server.
steps.safeguard: Client-side validation prevents malformed empty calls and preserves clean URL parameters (?q=...&source=gateway).

steps.title: Taxonomic Verification
steps.description: Inspects resolved summary metadata, botanical infobox cues, and family/order markers to confirm the subject is a genuine vascular or non-vascular plant species rather than an unrelated topic or homonym.
steps.safeguard: Non-botanical terms or unrecognized entities trigger clean 404 Smart Error Recovery with phonetic spelling suggestions.
steps.output: Verified Taxon Identity + Hero Specimen Plate

steps.title: 8-Chapter Schema Structuring
steps.description: Transforms raw global records into Plantipedia's standardized eight-chapter monograph structure covering Overview, Morphology, Taxonomy, Habitat, Ecology, Ethnobotany, Medicinal Profile, and Horticultural Care—enriched with glossary tooltip parsing.
steps.safeguard: Missing ecological telemetry fields degrade gracefully to verified family-level defaults without blank UI panels.

steps.title: Split Comparator & Field Export
steps.protocol: Shared Session Cache + A4 Print Engine
steps.description: Streams synthesized monographs directly into the dedicated Split Comparison Matrix (/compare/result/) alongside local curated species, while unlocking one-click APA/MLA/BibTeX citations and monochrome PDF field sheets.
steps.safeguard: Dual specimen routing works cross-source (Local × Local, Local × Global, or Global × Global) with full keyboard navigation.

features.description: Save curated or live-fetched specimens directly inside browser LocalStorage with zero tracking cookies, zero account walls, and instant drawer recall across research sessions.

features.title: Offline Shell & Local Catalog Continuity
features.description: Static JSON catalog caching and lightweight SVG botanical fallbacks ensure previously opened species indexes, seasonal charts, and citations stay usable even on unstable rural greenhouse connections.

standardsCta.heading: Engineered for Academic Interoperability, Accessibility & Privacy
standardsCta.lead: Every monograph and interactive utility follows open web standards so students, educators, and botanical institutions can reference Plantipedia with confidence.

cards.title: Schema.org JSON-LD
cards.description: Every page and species dossier injects structured Taxon, EducationalOrganization, WebSite, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD metadata for scholarly indexing and reproducible citation graphs.

cards.title: WCAG AA+ Contrast
cards.description: Jewel-tone accents are calibrated for >= 4.5:1 text contrast on dark botanical surfaces, paired with full keyboard tabbing, ARIA live regions, and prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks.

cards.title: Zero-Tracking Privacy
cards.description: No behavioral ad pixels, no third-party analytics trackers, and no forced sign-up gates. Your search history, citations, and saved Herbarium remain strictly on your own device.
